usage.how_to_update: Edit your worktree's entry before starting and after completing work; commit it on your branch. Use ISO 8601 timestamps. Set review_needed=true and fill review_detail when you need architect sign-off on an architect-owned file.
usage.how_to_read: Before starting any task, check all other worktrees for status=in_progress or review_needed. If another agent works in your file-ownership area, coordinate before editing.
